description: Returns deduplicated security findings for a project (all vaults) or a single vault. Provide exactly one of project_id or vault_id. Requires full data access (a paid plan; verification-only plans are not included). Requires X-API-Key (existing users can generate an API key in the web app). If headers aren't supported, pass api_key in arguments.

inputSchema.description: Provide exactly one of project_id or vault_id.

api_key.description: Optional API key for clients that cannot set X-API-Key headers.

check_id.description: Filter: exact match on the security check id.

file.description: Filter: substring match on file path.

issue_id.description: Return only this specific issue id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination.

project_id.description: Project id (from create_project). Returns data aggregated across all vaults in the project.

severity.description: Filter to one or more severities (e.g. ERROR, WARNING, INFO).

status.description: Filter: triage status (e.g. open, resolved, ignored).

vault_id.description: Vault id (from create-code-vault or list_vaults). Returns data for this vault only.

name: get-security-issues
